artifact: v2実売買実行仕様 PRETEST 1.0 データ品質アドオン

observed_data_issue.description: Yahoo/yfinance raw daily OHLC returned a small set of rows where Close was slightly outside the reported High/Low envelope. The initial realized-backtest attempts stopped at input validation before any realized trade metrics were produced.
observed_data_issue.selection_rule: The repair rule below is universal and is not limited to the known date or tickers.

frozen_repair_rule.scope: All raw OHLC rows loaded for PRETEST 1.0 before indicator calculation or order simulation.
frozen_repair_rule.if_high_invalid: If High < max(Open, High, Low, Close), replace High with max(Open, High, Low, Close).
frozen_repair_rule.if_low_invalid: If Low > min(Open, High, Low, Close), replace Low with min(Open, High, Low, Close).
frozen_repair_rule.post_condition: After repair, High >= max(Open, Close, Low) and Low <= min(Open, Close, High).
frozen_repair_rule.reason: This enforces the mathematical OHLC envelope while preserving every reported Open and Close. It is a source-data normalization rule, not an entry/exit optimization.

audit_requirements: Log every repaired row with ticker, date, original OHLC, repaired High/Low.
Fail the run if any OHLC envelope violation remains after the universal repair.
Report repair count in the final summary and human-readable report.

anti_hindsight.rule: Freeze this addendum and its SHA256 before the first successful PRETEST 1.0 realized-trade simulation. Do not alter this repair based on realized P/L.
anti_hindsight.future_changes: Any later data-cleaning change must be a new version/addendum and be pre-registered before a new OOS/forward evaluation.
